client_rules.offline: Do not optimistically commit join, leave, invite, create, update, or delete. Show retry UI only.
client_rules.404_opacity: Never distinguish missing vs private vs not joinable. Treat all 404 the same.
client_rules.401: Clear local session and re-authenticate via Auth sign-in.
client_rules.403: Show forbidden. Do not retry the same call as a different verb.
client_rules.422: Surface error.message and error.details when present. Do not navigate as if the write succeeded.
client_rules.decimals: Send price, latitude, longitude as numbers on write. Expect decimal strings on Event responses.

viewer_contexts.name: private_stranger

listEvents.intent: Browse matches the viewer may see that are still upcoming.
excludes: private events the viewer cannot see

getEvent.intent: Load one match plus current_user flags for CTAs.

updateEvent.who: author only; viewable non-author → 403; not viewable → 404

listEventTeams.intent: Show the three slots for team UI.

getEventTeam.intent: Single team detail for rename screen or team sheet.

updateEventTeam.intent: Rename a countable team label (not bench).

listEventParticipants.intent: Full roster for invite picker and event detail.

listEventTeamParticipants.intent: Roster for one team; preferred refetch after join/switch.

joinOrSwitchEventParticipant.refetch: listEventTeamParticipants for the target team (not the full event tree)

createEventInvitations.intent: Participant invites accepted friends not already in or invited.
